patch_description:
This version repairs the input graph by greedily retaining a C4-free subset of its original edges, then performs balanced saturation using the characterization that adding an edge is valid exactly when its endpoints have no length-three path between them.

Several input-dependent repair orders are tried. The best repaired graph is then improved through a small number of delete-and-refill perturbations: deleting a few high-degree edges can unlock several new valid edges. Every candidate is explicitly checked using the common-neighbor invariant, and a conservative repair fallback is included before returning.

The algorithm never substitutes a hard-coded construction: all edge priorities, repair choices, and perturbations are derived from the supplied adjacency matrix and RNG.
